English · Grade 4 · Module 4

How often? What time is it? ⏰

Let's talk about sports, routines and time!

🔊 Voice feedback: browser speech
Step 1 · Learn

How often?

We use How often? to ask about how many times we do something.

1 time
once a week

Once = one time.

2 times
twice a week

Twice = two times.

3 times
three times a week

Three times = three times.

4 times
four times a week

Four times = four times.

Every day
every day

We do it daily.

How do we make a question and an answer?

How often do you play tennis?
I play tennis twice a week.

How often does Tom play football?
He plays football four times a week.

Remember: with he / she / a name, use does in the question and add -s to the verb in the answer: play → plays.

Step 2 · Learn

What time is it?

We divide the clock into two halves with a line from 12 to 6.

RIGHT HALF · PAST

The right half is pink. If the big hand is here, use PAST.

LEFT HALF · TO

The left half is green. If the big hand is here, use TO.

PAST TO

Special expressions

3:00
three o'clock

Big hand at 12.

3:15
quarter past three

15 minutes after 3.

3:30
half past three

30 minutes after 3.

3:45
quarter to four

15 minutes to 4.

It's quarter past three.

Example to help you

Clues: 4 o'clock · play volleyball · twice a week

Full sentence: I play volleyball at four o'clock twice a week.

Ask your partner
  • What sport do you play?
  • How often do you play it?
  • What time do you play it?
Useful answers
  • I play volleyball.
  • I play it twice a week.
  • I play at four o'clock.

Student A: look at the card and answer. Student B: ask the three questions. Then swap roles.
